system.description:
Skill: Athletics

Exploit Type: Combat Exploit

Requirements: Blade Warden Subclass

You attempt a flurry of strikes that are impossible to track with your Warden Weapon. When you deal Lethal Attack damage using your Warden Weapon, you may choose to forgo up to 3 Lethal Attack damage dice. You strike fast enough and with enough force to manifest multiple afterimages of the same attack as you strike out against a number of creatures of your choice in your attacks range, as you repeat your attack against them once each dealing your attacks original damage plus the remaining Lethal Attack damage to each.
